outcome: composite adverse maternal outcome (increased blood loss, soft tissue injury, pre-eclampsia)
cohort: The study included 285 pregnant women diagnosed with GDM and 202 randomly selected women without GDM, all of whom gave birth after 37 weeks of pregnancy and underwent a 75g OGTT between 24-28 weeks.
finding: The study found no differences in most maternal and fetal outcomes between GDM and non-GDM women, with maternal abdominal circumference before delivery being a main predictor for significant perinatal complications, not the severity of carbohydrate intolerance.
